license.feature.audit_log.description.other: Allow access to audit log functionality.

license.feature.lite.provider_pools.desc.other: Allow CSGLite to group third-party model providers into pools with semantic routing.

license.feature.lite.observability.descr.other: Allow CSGLite request tracing, trace inspection and dataset export from observed requests.

license.feature.lite.remote_api_keys.des.other: Allow CSGLite to enforce API keys for remote callers and report per-key usage.

license.feature.lite.ai_apps.description.other: Allow CSGLite to install and manage enterprise agent applications.

license.feature.lite.realtime_voice.desc.other: Allow the CSGLite realtime speech (ASR + TTS) API.

license.feature.lite.image_generation.de.other: Allow CSGLite image generation and editing.

license.quota.lite.max_provider_pools.de.other: Maximum number of provider pools a CSGLite instance may configure; 0 means unlimited.
